title: occ20220329_8k.htm
主要内容: On March 29, 2022, Optical Cable Corporation held its annual meeting of shareholders. The meeting involved the election of five directors, approval of the First Amendment to the 2017 Stock Incentive Plan to reserve 350,000 additional Common Shares, ratification of the independent registered public accounting firm, and approval of executive compensation on a non-binding advisory basis. The amendment was ratified by shareholders, with 4,075,630 votes in favor, 649,391 against, and 6,423 abstentions. The company also ratified Brown, Edwards & Company L.L.P. as its independent registered public accounting firm. Shareholders approved the compensation of named executive officers on a non-binding advisory basis, with 4,122,077 votes in favor, 602,094 against, and 7,273 abstentions.
